spec.title: AI Coding Agents
spec.description: Claude Code and Codex CLI usage from their built-in OpenTelemetry export.

spec.title: Cost
spec.description: Sum of cost_usd on every api_request event. On a Pro/Max plan this is the API-equivalent value.

spec.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range]))
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])))

spec.title: Cache hit rate
spec.description: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache.

spec.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range])))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap ttft_ms [$__range]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by ()
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_error" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__auto]))

spec.title: Time to first token by model
spec.description: Time until the first token of each API response.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap ttft_ms [$__auto]) by (model)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap ttft_ms [$__auto]) by (model)
quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (model)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (model)

spec.title: Cost by source
spec.description: main = your conversation; others = subagents, compaction, etc.

spec.expr: sum by (query_source) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd [$__auto]))
sum by (status_code) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_error" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__auto]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__auto]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (tool_name)
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range]))

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | success="true" [$__range])) / sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (tool_name)

spec.title: Permission decisions
spec.description: accept / reject per tool, and whether it came from config, a hook, the user or auto mode.

spec.expr: sum by (tool_name, decision, source) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range]))
sum(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added", user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))
sum(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="removed", user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Active time
spec.description: Time actively using Claude Code (user typing + CLI working).

spec.expr: sum(increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))
sum(increase(claude_code_commit_count_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(increase(claude_code_pull_request_count_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{decision="accept", user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))
sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
sum by (user_email, model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range]))
sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range]))
sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))
sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap ttft_ms [$__range]) by (user_email, model)
{service_name="claude-code"} | event_name=~"api_error|api_refusal" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model"
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.user_prompt" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_token_count [$__range]))

spec.title: Cached input
spec.description: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache.

spec.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cached_token_count [$__range])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_token_count [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_token_count [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap reasoning_token_count [$__range]))

spec.title: p95 time to first token
spec.description: From prompt submitted to first token of the turn.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.turn_ttft" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by ()
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name=~"codex.api_request|codex.websocket_request" | user_email=~"$user" | success="false" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_token_count [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cached_token_count [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_token_count [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap reasoning_token_count [$__auto]))
sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_token_count [$__auto]))

sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_token_count [$__auto]))

spec.title: Time to first token by model
spec.description: Turn = from prompt to first token; response = per model response.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.turn_ttft" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (model)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.turn_ttft" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (model)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap ttft_ms [$__auto]) by (model)

spec.title: Turn duration p95 by model
spec.description: End-to-end turn time from Codex metrics (not filtered by user).

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name=~"codex.api_request|codex.websocket_request" | user_email=~"$user" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (event_name)
sum by (http_response_status_code, success) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name=~"codex.api_request|codex.websocket_request" | user_email=~"$user" [$__auto]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__auto]))

sum by (model, reasoning_effort, approval_policy, sandbox_policy) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.conversation_starts" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range]))
sum by (tool_name, decision, source) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_decision" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range]))

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | success="true" [$__range])) / sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (tool_name)
sum by (user_email, model) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range]))

sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_token_count [$__range]))

sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cached_token_count [$__range]))

sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_token_count [$__range]))

sum by (user_email, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | event_kind="response.completed" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap reasoning_token_count [$__range]))
